# Xila README header assets

Logo design by [Martin Legand](https://www.behance.net/martinlegand).

Generated from [xila-project/brand](https://github.com/xila-project/brand/tree/bf983b6709a824af145a1c4c46b31ac9ead79389) at commit `bf983b6709a824af145a1c4c46b31ac9ead79389`, identity version `2.0.0`.

The light and dark headers are transparent 1280 × 224 SVGs with outlined lettering.
They use the sister template's layout with lettering generated for the native
Rust template by brand's `scripts/repository_headers.py`. These deployment copies
need no local fonts or remote resources.

Lettering derives from Montserrat. The source font software retains its [SIL Open Font License](https://github.com/xila-project/brand/blob/bf983b6709a824af145a1c4c46b31ac9ead79389/fonts/OFL-Montserrat.txt).
